title: Salmon, Cucumber and Sesame Rice Bowl
summary: A light Japanese-style breakfast bowl with tender flaked salmon, cool cucumber and nutty sesame over warm rice. It’s fresh, savoury and quick enough for a weekday morning.
steps: Rinse the sushi rice until the water runs mostly clear, then cook it with the water according to the packet instructions until tender. Leave covered for 5 minutes after cooking.
While the rice cooks, season the salmon lightly with salt and cook it in a hot pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until just cooked through and easy to flake.
Mix the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil and sugar in a small bowl until the sugar dissolves.
Thinly slice the cucumber and spring onion.
Flake the salmon into large pieces.
Divide the rice between two bowls, top with the cucumber and salmon, then spoon over the dressing.
Finish with the spring onion and sesame seeds, and serve warm.
